product_one_liner.value: Lumilens builds photonic interconnects that help hyperscaler AI data centers expand GPU clusters and connect compute nodes.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page states that its photonic interconnects enable scale-out and scale-up AI architectures, allowing hyperscalers to expand GPU clusters and build denser compute nodes.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link, and the attempted pricing URL yielded no pricing page. This supports false under the specified website-navigation rule.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer-record section exposes no actual customer names, while the company's announcement refers to a customer agreement without identifying the customer. No two qualifying customer names were found. Investors, technology partners, and vendors have not been substituted for customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 164 associated employees; another headcount source reports 188 as of March 2026. Both fall within 101-200, though these are reported headcounts rather than a verified payroll census.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's profile identifies San Jose, and its principal address is in San Jose. These were preferred over other company-directory records showing Belmont; the conflicting directory locations lower confidence. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the United States, consistent with its principal address in San Jose, California.

founded_year.notes: Lumilens's company profile explicitly gives its founding year as 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The News & Insights index shows media coverage, a funding announcement, and one technical-adjacent blog article, 'Networks Are Now the AI Bottleneck.' It does not meet the requirement for at least two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link. The product pages reviewed are descriptive marketing pages, not a multi-article documentation site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official Join Lumilens page lists 'Machine Learning Engineer' and links to the company's openings. This is a qualifying title, although a separate role-specific application page was not verified.

model_provider.notes: No AI model or provider was identified in the reviewed product, manufacturing, blog, or legal material. Manufacturing mentions AI-optimized processes without naming a provider. The privacy policy does not publish its service-provider list and instead directs readers to request it by email. The provider is therefore unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed Terms of Use and Privacy Policy contain general legal and security obligations but no claims of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS compliance. The empty list reflects the reviewed legal pages, not a claim that the company has no certifications.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest recorded funding round is labeled Series C, and investor Redpoint independently states that it first partnered with Lumilens for its Series C in 2026. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the latest recorded round August 6, 2026, matching the dated company announcement. The requested year-month is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile records $700 million for the August 2026 Series C. The company's announcement describes the new financing as 'more than $700 million'; 700000000 is the reported round figure, not an assertion of exact unrounded proceeds. The over-$900-million figure is cumulative funding, not this round.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced more than $700 million in new funding on August 6, 2026, within the eighteen-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live official posting is titled 'Customer Sales Representative,' supporting true under the question's sales-representative title criterion. Important qualification: its description calls it a Customer Service Representative and emphasizes post-sales operations, so it is not evidence of a conventional outbound SDR or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 emergence announcement introduced Lumilens publicly while announcing that its first product was commercially shipping into production AI data centers. This launch-type announcement falls within the six-month window; the precise first-shipment date is not established.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Neera Patel's employment history gives an October 2026 start as Lumilens's Chief Financial Officer, within the twelve-month window. The company's leadership page also lists her as CFO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Business Process Manager posting explicitly names CRM (Salesforce). This is a visible hiring-stack signal, although a job requirement alone does not conclusively establish the production deployment. | crm_stack_signal.0: The official Business Process Manager posting explicitly names Salesforce as a CRM platform.
